verified_claims: The planning package is internally coherent and uses a deterministic, gated control plane.
Phase 4 and Phase 5 are enforceable in code because the pipeline state machine and memory layers are explicitly named.
The package correctly separates research, code execution, and approval boundaries.
unverified_claims: Exact availability and limits for all external providers in the target environment.
Official projects for Hermes Agent and OpenClaw if later source discovery is expected to resolve them.
Phase-0 capability details for non-Codex components until their self-verification tasks complete.
concerns: The package is broad enough that source discovery and evidence ingestion can dominate implementation cost if not staged tightly.
Some state-machine transitions depend on quality thresholds that are currently described but not yet operationalized as testable numeric gates.
The plan assumes separate research and execution contexts, but the enforcement mechanism for that separation still needs concrete adapter-level constraints.
required_changes: Add explicit acceptance thresholds and regression gates for each evaluation class before implementation begins.
Define the minimum viable source registry subset for the first implementation slice to avoid unbounded source expansion.
Specify the concrete adapter boundaries that prevent privileged tool access from external-source content.
